intro: Over 30 years of paintless dent repair on all makes and models. Hail, door dings and everyday dents worked out from behind the panel.
servicesIntro: Hail damage, everyday dents, and protective film, handled with the same hands-on care.

services.name: Hail damage repair
services.text: Many small dents on the roof, hood and doors, removed from behind the panel so the factory paint stays intact.

services.name: Everyday dents and dings
services.text: Door dings and parking lot dents repaired without repainting the panel.

services.name: Paint protection film
services.text: Clear film on high-impact areas shields paint from road debris and keeps the original finish visible.

services.name: Windshield protection film
services.text: Film that helps guard the glass against stones and road debris, applied for a clean, close fit.

why.name: Over 30 years in the trade
why.text: Three decades of paintless dent repair, one panel at a time.

why.name: Factory finish preserved
why.text: Tools work the metal from behind the panel, so the original paint stays wherever the dent allows.

why.name: All makes and models
why.text: Domestic, import and luxury vehicles get the same care on every panel.

howTitle: Back to like new in three steps.

steps.name: Send the details
steps.text: Call, or use the form with your year, make, model and photos of the damage.

steps.name: Get an evaluation
steps.text: Bring the vehicle in and we look at the hail damage, dings or film options.

steps.name: Drive it smooth
steps.text: We work the dents out and hand the vehicle back.
